title: NSA Glomar response cites Executive Order 13526
summary: Jesse Michels tells of NSA Glomar response cites Executive Order 13526, about 2023 at NSA, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: their exact response, "This agency has determined that the fact of the existence or non-existence [music] of the material you request is a currently improperly classified matter

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2023 a person named Noah Hradek used a US law that lets anyone request government records to ask the NSA, America's electronic spying agency, for certain material. Michels says the agency gave what is called a Glomar response, a reply that will neither confirm nor deny that records exist, saying that even whether the material exists is a classified matter, citing Executive Order 13526, the presidential order that sets the rules for government secrets. He tells it because it would suggest the agency is guarding something it will not even admit to having.
